name: Elk
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 10 and Stealth 10. No listed special senses. No listed languages.
appearance: A tall, heavy-bodied deer with a shaggy brown neck, pale rump, and long legs. A bull carries branching antlers.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, page 357. XP comes from the CR table on p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR +2, DEX +0, CON +1, INT −4, WIS +0, CHA −2.
sections.Traits: Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target, then hit it with Ram on the same turn to deal another 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must also pass a DC 12 Strength save or fall prone.
sections.Actions:
Ram. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Kick. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage. The target makes a DC 12 Strength save or is pushed up to 10 ft. away from the elk.

name: Elk
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 10. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A tall, heavy-bodied deer with a shaggy brown neck, pale rump, and long legs. A bull carries branching antlers.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual, first printing (September 2014), printed p. 322. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16857-elk
sections.Traits: Charge. Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a target, then hit it with Ram on the same turn to deal another 7 (2d6) damage. A creature hit must also pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone.
sections.Actions:
Ram. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one prone creature. Hit for 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

name: Owl
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 13 and Stealth 13. Darkvision 120 ft. No listed languages.
appearance: A small barn owl with a pale heart-shaped face, dark eyes, mottled tawny wings, and hooked talons.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, page 365. XP comes from the CR table on p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR −4, DEX +1, CON −1, INT −4, WIS +1, CHA −2.
sections.Traits:
Flyby. The owl can leave an enemy’s reach in flight without provoking an opportunity attack from that enemy.
Heightened Hearing and Sight. Use Perception 18 when detecting by sight or hearing.
Quiet Wings. Use Stealth 18 while flying.
sections.Actions: Talons. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one creature. Hit for 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.

name: Pony
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 10 and Stealth 10. No listed special senses. No listed languages.
appearance: A compact, broad-backed horse with short sturdy legs, a chestnut coat, a pale mane, and a white facial blaze.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, page 366. XP comes from the CR table on p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR +2, DEX +0, CON +1, INT −4, WIS +0, CHA −2.
sections.Traits: Draft Animal. Read the trait under Pony as allowing it to push, drag, or lift up to three times its carrying capacity. The printed sentence names a draft horse. The pony’s block supplies no carrying capacity in pounds.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

name: Quipper
publication: Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2
otherStatistics: Fixed Perception 8 and Stealth 10. Darkvision 60 ft. No listed languages.
appearance: A small, deep-bodied predatory fish with silvery green scales, a copper belly, and triangular teeth in a jutting lower jaw.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, page 366. XP comes from the CR table on p. 229.
sections.Ability modifiers: STR −4, DEX +0, CON +0, INT −5, WIS −2, CHA −4.
sections.Traits:
Blood Frenzy. The quipper has advantage on melee attack rolls against creatures below their maximum HP.
Heightened Smell. Use Perception 13 when detecting by smell.
Water Breathing. The quipper breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one creature. Hit for 2 (1d4) piercing damage.
